title: Source document manifest
description: The provenance record for every authoritative document Aadesh cites. `make verify` re-hashes the bytes on disk and compares them to this manifest, then re-checks every quote against the extracted page text.

publisher.description: The issuing authority, e.g. 'Commission for Air Quality Management'.

source_url.description: The OFFICIAL domain the bytes were downloaded from. A news article or mirror is not an acceptable source.

sha256.description: Hash of the exact downloaded bytes. Re-checked by `make verify`.

local_path.description: Path to the committed original bytes, relative to the corpus root.

pages_dir.description: Directory of extracted per-page text files named p<N>.txt, relative to the corpus root.

supersedes.description: doc_ids this order amends or replaces. GRAP has been revised repeatedly. If you cannot establish which order is CURRENT for a measure, drop that measure.
